_comment: Single source of truth for the fire event this project models. Every script and the webapp read from this file.
name_el: Μεγάλη πυρκαγιά Δυτικής Αττικής – Βοιωτίας 2026 (Ψάθα / Πόρτο Γερμενό)
name_en: 2026 West Attica–Boeotia mega fire (Psatha / Porto Germeno)
notes: Core 4-day mega-fire window per news reporting ('fourth consecutive day' as of 2026-08-03). Flare-ups, re-ignitions and mop-up continued after this window (reported through at least 2026-08-06); treat dates after 2026-08-03 as an 'aftermath' phase, not the main burn.

ignition._comment: lat/lon corrected 2026-08-10: the original value (23.0264076 lon) came from a Google Maps viewport link and sat ~17km out in open water in the Gulf of Corinth, not on land. Replaced with Porto Germeno/Aigosthena's real coordinate, cross-checked against two independent sources: a web search (converging on ~38.147-38.156N, 23.22-23.23E across Wikipedia/Wikidata-derived results) and this project's own works.json, which has a geocoded 'Porto Germeno' work address at 38.149079, 23.230977. Still an approximation of the village/area, not a surveyed exact ignition point.
ignition.location_name: Boeotia / West Attica border, near Psatha and Porto Germeno (northern shore of the Gulf of Corinth)
ignition.location_name_el: σύνορα Βοιωτίας – Δυτικής Αττικής, κοντά στην Ψάθα και το Πόρτο Γερμενό (βόρεια ακτή Κορινθιακού κόλπου)
ignition.suspected_cause: Reported in initial press coverage as linked to a wind (power) turbine; UNCONFIRMED — treat as 'reported cause pending official investigation', not established fact. Verify against Hellenic Fire Service / official investigation findings before publishing as fact.
ignition.suspected_cause_el: Σύμφωνα με τα πρώτα δημοσιεύματα, αποδίδεται σε ανεμογεννήτρια· ΑΝΕΠΙΒΕΒΑΙΩΤΟ — να αντιμετωπίζεται ως πιθανή αιτία εν αναμονή επίσημης έρευνας, όχι ως τεκμηριωμένο γεγονός. Να επαληθευτεί από την Πυροσβεστική / επίσημη έρευνα πριν δημοσιευτεί ως γεγονός.

bbox._comment: min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat — covers Psatha, Porto Germeno, Villia, Megara, Erythres/Boeotia border, Geraneia mountains. Widen if FIRMS/EFFIS rows near the edges look clipped.

weather_reference_point._comment: Deliberately left at the OLD (pre-correction) ignition coordinate, not the corrected one above: this is the exact point data/weather/hourly.json and wind_grid.json were already fetched for. Changing it here without re-running scripts/fetch_weather.py + fetch_wind_grid.py would silently mismatch the label and the underlying data. TODO: update to the corrected ignition point and re-fetch weather before next data refresh.

known_facts._comment: Pulled from news coverage during scaffolding (2026-08-07). These are starting points for the narrative, not verified primary-source facts — cross-check against official Hellenic Fire Service / Copernicus EMS reports before publishing.
known_facts.casualties: 2 firefighters and a Danish pilot died when two firefighting helicopters collided (reported Sunday 2026-08-02).
known_facts.casualties_el: 2 πυροσβέστες και ένας Δανός πιλότος έχασαν τη ζωή τους όταν συγκρούστηκαν δύο πυροσβεστικά ελικόπτερα (η είδηση αναφέρθηκε την Κυριακή 2/8/2026).
known_facts.wind_reported: Gusty, dry 'meltemi' winds reported at 80-100 km/h during the worst days; cross-check against actual hourly wind speed/gusts pulled from Open-Meteo historical archive for the exact reference point/dates.
known_facts.wind_reported_el: Αναφέρθηκαν ισχυροί, ξηροί άνεμοι («μελτέμια») έως 80-100 χλμ/ώ τις χειρότερες ημέρες· να διασταυρωθεί με τα πραγματικά ωριαία στοιχεία ανέμου από το ιστορικό αρχείο Open-Meteo για το ακριβές σημείο αναφοράς/ημερομηνίες.
